note: Heading provides a 'heading' field type (HeadingItem: columns text varchar255 + size char2; default widget 'heading', default formatter 'heading'; field settings label + allowed_sizes subset of h1-h6) and a separate 'heading_text' formatter for core string/text fields (single 'size' setting, default h2, wraps value in an html_tag of that size). The 'heading' formatter renders via the theme hook 'heading' (template heading.html.twig: <{{size}}>{{text}}</{{size}}>). Also registers size/text tokens per heading field via hook_token_info_alter. No admin settings page, no permissions, no Drush, configure=null; config schema provided. Medium/hard cases create heading and string fields on the core Article type and read/write field.field.* settings and core.entity_view_display.node.article.default components.

evals.prompt: I want editors to add a section title to Article nodes where they can also choose the heading level (h1-h6), rendered as a real <h2>/<h3>/etc. The 'heading' contrib module provides this. What field type do I add, and what are its two stored parts?
evals.expected_output: Add a field of type 'heading' (the module's HeadingItem field type). It stores two columns: 'text' (the heading text, varchar 255) and 'size' (the level, e.g. h2). Its default widget is 'heading' (textfield + size select) and default formatter 'heading' renders it as <size>text</size> via the heading theme hook.

evals.prompt: With the heading module, how can I display an EXISTING plain string or text field as a heading of a specific level without creating a new field? Name the formatter and its setting (and its default).
evals.expected_output: Use the 'heading_text' field formatter (applies to core string and text fields). Set its single 'size' setting to the desired level (h1-h6); the default is h2. It wraps the field value in an html_tag of that size. Configured on the entity's Manage display.

evals.prompt: On a 'heading' field from the heading module, how do I restrict which heading levels an editor can choose, and what happens in the widget if only one level is allowed?
evals.expected_output: Use the field's 'allowed_sizes' setting (checkboxes of h1-h6) to limit the choices; default is all of h1-h6. If exactly one size is allowed the widget hides the size select and applies that single size automatically (a fixed value element).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a heading-module 'heading' field named field_hdg_known whose allowed heading levels have been restricted. Inspect the live field configuration and list exactly which heading sizes are allowed.
evals.expected_output: field_hdg_known allows only h2 and h3: field.field.node.article.field_hdg_known -> settings.allowed_sizes = [h2, h3]. Read with: drush cget field.field.node.article.field_hdg_known settings.allowed_sizes

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has a string field 'field_hdg_sub' that is displayed using the heading module's heading_text formatter. Inspect the live display configuration and state which heading size it is configured to output.
evals.expected_output: It is configured at size h4: core.entity_view_display.node.article.default -> content.field_hdg_sub has type heading_text with settings.size = h4. Read with: drush cget core.entity_view_display.node.article.default content.field_hdg_sub

evals.prompt: On this site, using the heading module, add a new Heading field named field_hdg_task to the Article content type (entity type node, bundle article) so editors get a text + heading-level field. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a FieldStorageConfig (entity_type node, field_name field_hdg_task, type 'heading') and a FieldConfig attaching it to bundle article, then save. verify passes when node.article.field_hdg_task exists with field type 'heading'.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article type has a plain string field 'field_hdg_fmt' currently shown with the default string formatter. Using the heading module, change its default display so the field renders as a heading. Apply the change to the live default view display.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_hdg_fmt component in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default to formatter type 'heading_text' (optionally a size setting) and save. verify passes when the component's formatter type is heading_text.
